symbols.each: Each circle is one warning. What the colours mean:

sheet.follow: Always follow instructions from the district administration, the police and IMD.

flood.a: Stay away from rivers, lakes, drains and low-lying roads.
flood.b: Do not walk or drive through flood water.
flood.c: Keep your phone charged, and drinking water and medicines ready.
flood.d: Move to higher ground if officials ask you to.

storm.a: Stay indoors during thunder and lightning.
storm.b: Keep away from trees, electric poles and hanging wires.
storm.c: Do not go near rivers or drains in heavy rain.

heat.a: Drink water often, even if you are not thirsty.
heat.b: Stay out of the sun between 12 noon and 3 pm.
heat.c: Wear light, loose cotton clothes and cover your head.
heat.d: Check on old people, small children and animals.

cold.a: Wear warm clothes in layers and cover your head.
cold.b: Keep old people and small children warm.
cold.c: Never keep a coal or wood fire burning in a closed room.

quake.a: Stay away from slopes, cracked buildings and fallen wires.
quake.b: Follow instructions from the district administration.
quake.c: Keep an emergency bag: water, medicines, a torch and your documents.

fire.a: Keep away from the place and let rescue teams work.
fire.b: Call 101 for fire, or 112 for any emergency.
fire.c: Do not forward messages you have not checked.

water.a: Store enough water for drinking and cooking.
water.b: Use water carefully until the supply is back.
water.c: Boil or filter water before drinking.

power.a: Charge your phone and power bank.
power.c: Switch off appliances so they are safe when power comes back.

health.a: Wash your hands with soap often.
health.c: See a doctor early if you have fever, cough or loose motions.
health.d: Do not let water collect around your home: mosquitoes breed in it.

travel.a: Roads, buses or shops may be closed: plan ahead.
travel.b: Take another route if you can.
travel.c: Follow what the police tell you.

general.a: Read the full notice and follow official instructions.
general.b: Share it with the people it concerns; do not forward rumours.

end.notOfficial: ForThePeople.in is not an official government website. Data is gathered from public government portals under India's Open Data Policy (NDSAP).
